cli.stop_help.stop: Stop a running lop session (graceful, then signals)
cli.stop_help.all: stop every session on this machine (prompts on a TTY; --yes to skip)
cli.stop_help.yes: skip the --all confirmation (required when stdin is not a TTY)
cli.stop_help.timeout: graceful-op wait per session before escalating (default 10)
cli.stop_help.force: escalate past a refusal or a skip: signal a target whose socket cannot confirm identity, one that reports a turn in flight, or one already leaving after a signal — each of those can cut the turn it is in. Not needed for a cooperative mid-turn runtime: the plain stop ends that one promptly, through its socket
cli.refresh_help.refresh: Ask running sessions to move to the build on disk at their next boundary (no signals)
cli.refresh_help.all: ask every live session on this machine (no confirmation: nothing is ended)
cli.refresh_help.timeout: wait per session for its answer (default 10)
cli.monitor_help.monitor: Inspect standing monitors and cancel one on a closed session
cli.monitor_help.status: every monitor on this machine, soonest first
cli.monitor_help.cancel: cancel a monitor on a session with no runtime open (a live session changes its own monitors from inside)
cli.monitor_help.session: session id the monitor belongs to
